subject.title: [Bug]: 2 codex accounts, same machine, same docs, one has balloon startup cost

question: Should default local stdio Codex app-server state be split by auth profile, and what should happen to existing per-agent codex-home state?
rationale: The source path supports account-scoped isolation, but changing CODEX_HOME affects Codex auth, sessions, logs, plugins, caches, and operator docs, so automation should not choose the upgrade/reset policy alone.

options.title: Profile-scope with explicit reset or migration
options.body: Land profile-scoped CODEX_HOME after maintainers choose and document reset, migration, cleanup, and proof requirements for existing users.

options.title: Keep per-agent storage and investigate another cause
options.body: Preserve the current storage boundary and require live diagnostics to find a non-CODEX_HOME source for the cached-prefix delta.

options.title: Defer until live maintainer proof
options.body: Keep the issue open without implementation until a maintainer can reproduce the two-account setup and approve the storage behavior.

recommendation.title: Profile-scope with explicit reset or migration
recommendation.body: Land profile-scoped CODEX_HOME after maintainers choose and document reset, migration, cleanup, and proof requirements for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest history on the Codex OAuth/profile-owned runtime boundary and authored the earlier profile-scoped home proposal.
